parts.note_add: S-001 p24 (G-04): switched feed LgW comes through the stereo/deck position G-03 from LR (X-04 20 A, ACC), illumination RG 3.4 W, LG to the power antenna relay; speakers LG/LW (front LH) and LY/LR (front RH) on a 4-pole plug; DIN cord to the main amp. Shaft-type radio, not DIN size (src-wrighthere-stereo). confirm: what bridges G-03 on a GS with no tape deck.
Knobs pull off the radio shafts; the 1980 manual removes the knobs, then the shaft nuts and bezel (S-045 section 15, other-car).
Joins the radio to the main amplifier (S-001 p24 'DIN CODE' between G-04 and G-08); carries the rear-channel signal. Pinout for '82 not given; 1985 layout recorded as other-car.
Radio case ground; S-001 p24 draws the radio grounded through its case, not a harness pin. confirm the earth point on the car.

S-001 p24 (G-08): power L from connector G-07 (LR, X-04 20 A), outputs LR/LO to rear LH (G-09) and LW/LB to rear RH (G-10); drives only the rear speakers, the radio drives the fronts. 1985 manual's equivalent 'System 3' puts the 5 W x 2 amp under the rear storage area (S-002 15-63, other-car).
The '82 GS wiring (S-001 p24) shows only one amplifier, the 5 W x 2 main amp; no front power amp appears, so this part is likely not on a '82 GS. confirm on the car.

Driven directly by the radio: LH G-05 LG/LW, RH G-06 LY/LR (S-001 p24), LH through connector X-02. Factory check (1985 manual, other-car): impedance across one channel should equal the rated impedance, and infinite to body (S-002 15-67, 15-71).
No first-gen grille listed at Atkins Rotary (Sept 2026); used only.

The '82 brochure gives two-way coaxial rear speakers only to the GSL (S-004 p15), so the GS rear is most likely the 5 in single cone 0000-81-0643. Driven by the main amp: LH G-09 LR/LO, RH G-10 LW/LB (S-001 p24). confirm on the car.
Catalogue fig 6680A-2 (S-005 BI p105) draws 66975 running from the dash round the cabin to the rear speakers; it carries the amp-to-rear-speaker circuits LR/LO/LW/LB of S-001 p24. confirm.
Drawn in the FB331..633361- inset of fig 6680A-2 (S-005 BI p105) next to the amplifier.

Catalogue fig 6680A-2 (S-005 BI p105) draws the diode (67242A) plugged into the harness at the HEAD LAMP RETRACTOR MOTOR, so the two sit one at each pop-up motor, filed under audio (likely radio noise suppression). confirm on the car.
